'''The Black Hole''' was the name given to the worst part of the [[Off-Worlders' Quarter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ropagi II]]. It was the location of the world's [[Black market/Legends|black market]], and was where criminals, [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] congregated. The black market sold weapons with at least a fifty percent mark-up.<ref name="Ropagi II" />
